name: Crumpet's workbench
about: A character set: Crumpet the baby beaver (a posed character, his cast sheet on him) building a toy at his workbench, in a woodshop of 17 parts (library pieces and shapes), with two cameras and the 3D page's work: one sheet and one 3D model per object. Clay frame and depth sent at 55%. Its three renders (the workbench, a close-up and a storybook look) were made for this example with GPT Image from the clay frames kept with them, for free.

parts.name: Floor
parts.made: worn wide pine floorboards dusted with wood shavings

parts.name: Back wall
parts.made: a honey-coloured plank wall with a small four-pane window onto snowy pine woods

parts.name: Workbench
parts.made: a chunky pine workbench scarred with saw cuts and pencil marks, a wooden vice at one end

parts.name: Crumpet
parts.made: a baby beaver with chestnut fur, a cream tummy, rosy cheeks, two big front teeth and a flat brown tail

parts.name: Bench lamp
parts.made: an old green enamel desk lamp, its warm bulb glowing

parts.name: Wooden toy
parts.made: a little wooden toy of stacked pine blocks, a round peg and a red triangle

parts.name: Nail jar
parts.made: a clear glass jar with a plain lid, filled to the brim with nails and brass screws, matte and dull, no shine or reflections

parts.name: Cocoa
parts.made: a chipped blue mug of steaming cocoa

parts.name: Tool board
parts.made: a pegboard of small hand tools: a saw, a hammer, chisels and a folding ruler

parts.name: Plank
parts.made: a thick solid pine plank, a board about five centimetres thick with square edges, flat faces and visible end grain, leaning on the wall

parts.name: Plank 2
parts.made: a thick solid pine plank, a board about five centimetres thick with square edges, flat faces and visible end grain, leaning on the wall

parts.name: Shelf
parts.made: an open plank shelf unit: a tall frame with four open shelves you can see into and through, crowded with tins, pencils, glue pots and little carved wooden animals

parts.name: Offcuts crate
parts.made: a wooden crate overflowing with pine offcuts

parts.name: Log
parts.made: a fresh-cut birch log, gnawed to a point at one end

parts.name: Stump stool
parts.made: a tree-stump stool, its top worn smooth

parts.name: Clock
parts.made: a round wooden wall clock with an acorn painted on its face
